description: Save an outfit to the signed-in person's wardrobe from item ids they own, typically the ids suggest_outfit just returned. Give it a short name (e.g. 'Client dinner'). Works only once the person has turned on 'Allow assistants to change my wardrobe' under Profile → Connected assistants in the Alama app; otherwise it refuses and nothing is saved. Free accounts have a saved-outfit limit, shared with the app. Never deletes or changes an existing outfit.
name: create_saved_outfit
